title: A new route
passage: The familiar road was closed, so I tried another way home. At first I kept comparing every turn with the route I knew. Later I noticed a useful shortcut and a pleasant place to stop. The unfamiliar road had details worth discovering.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.

Save one observation and one real-life use.
